description: PARSEC's own characteristics and its mapping into the stellariso unified vocabulary (definitions in registry/unified_parameters.json). Loaded and validated together with the definitions by stellariso.registry.
notes: Column names follow the CMD isochrone-table format (see the reader module).
Stage labels follow the official CMD FAQ, which itself cautions that labels are approximate and not carefully checked for all masses and metallicities.

Mass-loss sign convention difference: MIST's star_mdot is negative while the star loses mass; CMD's logMdot is log10 of the (positive) rate. Both are preserved natively; the unified signed mass_loss_rate is mapped only for MIST, and PARSEC keeps logMdot under log_mass_loss_rate to avoid a silent sign/representation change.

field_mappings.description: initial (age-zero) mass of the isochrone point
actual mass including the mass-loss history (Reimers RGB winds with the eta stated in the file header)
CMD evolutionary stage label (approximate per the official FAQ)

field_mappings.transformation: CMD stage label mapped to unified coarse stages

field_mappings.description: photospheric C/O ratio (ZAMS value printed before the TP-AGB)
H-exhausted core mass on the TP-AGB (0 before it)
log10 of the mass-loss rate in Msun/yr (positive quantity; meaningful mainly on the TP-AGB)

alternatives.description: initial metal mass fraction as stated by the per-isochrone header lines
CMD tables do not restate Z per file; recover it from the generating request (see provenance) or the block headers

parameters.name: initial_helium
parameters.description: scaled-solar helium enrichment law of the PARSEC v1.2S grid (stated on the CMD form)

parameters.name: alpha_fe
parameters.description: scaled-solar (CAF09) composition; the CMD v1.2S products carry no alpha enhancement

parameters.name: initial_rotation
parameters.description: PARSEC v1.2S tracks are non-rotating; rotation exists only in the PARSEC v2.0 products

field_mappings.description: initial mass, stated by the track filename (Z...Y...OUTA..._M<mass:7.3f>.DAT pattern), not by a column
stellar mass in Msun (official readme: 'stellar mass'); constant along tracks without wind mass loss
log10 effective temperature in K (official readme words it as 'effective temperature in K'; the printed values are the base-10 logarithm)
official readme: 'stellar radius in Log cm'; shifted to log10(R/Rsun) with the IAU 2015 nominal solar radius

field_mappings.transformation: log10(G * MASS[Msun] * Msun_g / (10**LOG_R[cm])**2), G = 6.67430e-8 cm3 g-1 s-2 (CODATA 2018), Msun_g = 1.98847e33 g (IAU 2015 nominal solar mass); the tracks print no gravity column

field_mappings.description: official readme: 'mass of H exhausted core' — the core inside the H-burning shell
official readme: 'mass of He exhausted core'
PARSEC track phase (critical point number); fractional values between integers are intentional, designed for interpolation

field_mappings.transformation: floor(PHASE + 1e-9) mapped to unified coarse stages; the official readme names the column but does not enumerate the codes — the mapping below was derived from the physical state at each integer transition (central abundances, nuclear luminosity fractions, core masses) in the published Z=0.0001Y0.249 set

field_mappings.description: not mapped: the track LOG_RAT column uses a -30 sentinel for 'no mass loss', which is not a log10 rate

phase_code_meanings.1: track start, fully convective pre-main sequence (LX = 0)
phase_code_meanings.8: shell hydrogen burning / Hertzsprung crossing into the giant branch
phase_code_meanings.15: final computed stage (C ignition in massive stars / track end; codes beyond 15 are not enumerated and map to unknown)

hb_phase_code_meanings.1: horizontal-branch track start, core helium burning (H_CEN = 0, HE_CEN ~ 0.95)

notes: Files follow the official readme of the PARSEC v1.2S track database (Bressan+2012; Chen+2014; Tang+2014; Chen+2015; Fu+2018).

One plain-text file per initial mass, whitespace-separated: MODELL MASS AGE LOG_L LOG_TE LOG_R LOG_RAT M_CORE_HE M_CORE_C H_CEN HE_CEN C_cen O_cen LX LY LC LNEUTR L_GRAV H_SUP HE_SUP C_SUP N_SUP O_SUP PHASE. AGE is in years; LOG_R is log10(R/cm).
The single *ADD.DAT file in each zip is discarded (official readme instruction: it only exists to merge sections across critical points).

The *.HB.DAT files are horizontal-branch (post-helium-flash) tracks of low-mass stars; their PHASE numbering restarts with its own meaning and uses the separate hb mapping. They are parsed but excluded from isochrone synthesis (the helium flash is discontinuous; bridging it is not attempted).
The PHASE column is fractional between integers by design; codes are floored before stage mapping.
LOG_RAT (log mass-loss rate) keeps its -30 'no mass loss' sentinel and is therefore not exposed as a unified field.
The phase-code mapping is stellariso's derivation from physical inspection of the published tracks, not an official enumeration — the official readme names PHASE but lists no code table.

parameters.name: initial_mass
parameters.description: initial masses of the track files present in this set (stated by the filenames)

parameters.name: initial_z
parameters.description: initial metallicity Z, stated by the zip/directory name (e.g. Z0.0001Y0.249)

parameters.name: initial_helium
parameters.description: initial helium fraction Y, stated by the zip/directory name next to Z
